known_account.scope: same historical period reused, not a new untouched holdout; false positives unknown without labels

account_excluded.scope: same historical period reused, not a new untouched holdout; false positives unknown without labels

templates.selection: at least 6 posts and 24 late intervals, >=2 intervals/post, up to 12 posts by SHA256(id); no anomaly-label selection

component_calibration.scope: new random worlds from same stated families and fixed masks; no stronger guarantee on real MAX
